about_the_game:
Adds a unique academy-themed costume for both Yumia and Flammi (two total).

List of Contents:
- "High-Class Dream Style" Costume for Yumia
- "Boba Tea" Costume for Flammi

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room.
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
